description: This file appears to be the core implementation of the FatFs module, a generic FAT filesystem library written in C. It contains macros, data structures, and functions related to FAT filesystem management such as cluster management, FAT table access, directory operations, and filesystem parameters. The content indicates it's part of an embedded/OS-level system supporting FAT filesystems, with references to external files 'ff.h' and 'diskio.h' for API declarations and device I/O.

methods.name: ld_word
methods.description: Load a 2-byte little-endian word from a byte array.

methods.name: ld_dword
methods.description: Load a 4-byte little-endian DWORD from a byte array.

methods.name: ld_qword
methods.description: Load an 8-byte little-endian QWORD from a byte array (exFAT).

methods.name: st_word
methods.description: Store a 2-byte little-endian word into a byte array.

methods.name: st_dword
methods.description: Store a 4-byte little-endian DWORD into a byte array.

methods.name: st_qword
methods.description: Store an 8-byte little-endian QWORD into a byte array (exFAT).

methods.name: mem_cpy
methods.description: Copy a specified number of bytes from source to destination memory.

methods.name: mem_set
methods.description: Fill a memory block with a specified byte value.

methods.name: mem_cmp
methods.description: Compare two memory blocks byte-by-byte.

methods.name: chk_chr
methods.description: Check if a character is contained within a string.

methods.name: dbc_1st
methods.description: Test if a byte is the first byte in a DBCS character for the current code page.

methods.name: dbc_2nd
methods.description: Test if a byte is the second byte in a DBCS character for the current code page.

methods.name: lock_fs
methods.description: Request a lock grant on a filesystem object (reentrant).

methods.name: unlock_fs
methods.description: Release a lock grant on a filesystem object (reentrant).

methods.name: chk_lock
methods.description: Check if a file can be accessed with desired permissions.

methods.name: enq_lock
methods.description: Check if a lock entry slot is available.

methods.name: inc_lock
methods.description: Increment the open count of a lock entry.

methods.name: dec_lock
methods.description: Decrement the open count of a lock entry.

methods.name: clear_lock
methods.description: Clear all lock entries associated with a volume.

methods.name: sync_window
methods.description: Write back the filesystem window to disk if dirty.

methods.name: move_window
methods.description: Move or refresh the filesystem window to a specific sector.

methods.name: sync_fs
methods.description: Synchronize filesystem metadata and data to storage device.

methods.name: clst2sect
methods.description: Convert a cluster number to a sector number in the filesystem.

methods.name: get_fat
methods.description: Read the value of a FAT entry for a given cluster.

methods.name: put_fat
methods.description: Change the value of a FAT entry for a cluster.

methods.name: find_bitmap
methods.description: Find a contiguous block of free clusters in the FAT bitmap (exFAT).

methods.name: change_bitmap
methods.description: Set or clear bits in the FAT allocation bitmap (exFAT).

methods.name: fill_first_frag
methods.description: Create a contiguous chain in the FAT from the start cluster.

methods.name: fill_last_frag
methods.description: Fill in the last fragment of a FAT chain with a specified end value.

methods.name: remove_chain
methods.description: Remove and free a cluster chain in the FAT.

methods.name: create_chain
methods.description: Create or extend a cluster chain in the FAT.

methods.name: clmt_clust
methods.description: Convert a file offset to a cluster number using the cluster link map.

methods.name: dir_clear
methods.description: Clear (zero out) all entries in a directory cluster.

methods.name: dir_sdi
methods.description: Set the directory index to a specific offset.

methods.name: dir_next
methods.description: Move to the next directory entry, possibly stretching the directory.

methods.name: dir_alloc
methods.description: Allocate a block of directory entries.

methods.name: ld_clust
methods.description: Load the starting cluster number from a directory entry.

methods.name: st_clust
methods.description: Store a starting cluster number into a directory entry.

methods.name: cmp_lfn
methods.description: Compare a portion of filename with an LFN entry for matching.
